# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments/{id}/reactions

Get a list of reactions from a comment of an issue

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-300`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| id | path | integer (int64) | True |

## Response

**200** — []api.Reaction

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `user` | api.User | The user who created the reaction |
| `content` | string | The reaction type/emoji |
| `created_at` | time.Time | When the reaction was created |

- **403** — no permission to read issues/pulls
- **404** — comment not found or belongs to different repo

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| User must have read permission for issues or pulls to view comment reactions | authorization | !ctx.Repo.Permission.CanReadIssuesOrPulls(comment.Issue.IsPull) |
| Comment must belong to the same repository | validation | comment.Issue.RepoID != ctx.Repo.Repository.ID |
| FindReactions filters by allowed reaction types from settings | business_logic | always applied |

### Error Paths

- **comment not found** → GetIssueCommentReactions → 404
- **comment belongs to different repo** → GetIssueCommentReactions → 404
- **no read permission for issues/pulls** → GetIssueCommentReactions → 403
